description: This file defines the LiveActivityManager class responsible for managing live activities within an iOS app using ActivityKit. It handles starting, updating, and terminating live activities, focusing on connection states and cleanup of duplicates.

classes.name: LiveActivityManager
classes.description: A singleton class managing the lifecycle of live activities, including starting, updating, and pruning duplicates based on activity state.

methods.name: startActivity
methods.description: Initiates a new live activity if none exists, with provided agent name and session key.

methods.name: handleConnecting
methods.description: Updates the current activity state to 'connecting'.

methods.name: handleDisconnect
methods.description: Marks the current activity as disconnected.

methods.name: hydrateCurrentAndPruneDuplicates
methods.description: Ensures the current activity is the most recent and ends any stale duplicate activities.

methods.name: updateCurrent
methods.description: Updates the current activity's state asynchronously.

methods.name: connectingState
methods.description: Returns the content state representing a connecting status.

methods.name: idleState
methods.description: Returns the content state representing an idle status.

methods.name: disconnectedState
methods.description: Returns the content state representing a disconnected status.
